Docs/Replay/Guide

Replay

Cavecrawl social detail acceptance

1 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓
Shell
REPLAY_CAVE_SOCIAL_OUT=/absolute/fresh/output nix develop --command bash tests/replay_cave_social/run.sh

The runner builds an isolated Cavecrawl copy, runs native host/client/observer processes with 120 ms receive delay, and exports a separate Chrome project with the existing coordinator-backed migration fixture. The unchanged shared telemetry and Comms unit gates can also be run with tests/replay_telemetry/run.sh and tests/replay_comms/run.sh.

A native keyboard gate types F and submits invalid/valid names with Enter, requiring continued editing on rejection and no ping/chat side effects.

Native checks require the authority's zero row and a measured remote RTT, hide observer and departed rows, then leave/rejoin with a fresh measurement. A ping stamped Beta stays Beta while a rename to Scout [x] is accepted; a subsequent ping uses the new name. Both actual Label nodes must coexist and then expire. The rendered host captures the scoreboard. An isolated zero-dweller floor keeps this UI scenario free of unrelated combat.

Chrome retains the original three-player lobby/chat/loot/door/handoff/continuation workflow. The fixture holds handoff until measurements are visible and the existing durable gameplay condition is met. Only then does the guest send a marker, so its pre-expiry removal at the epoch transition can be distinguished from ordinary expiry. Every peer must adopt telemetry scope 2, display the new authority's zero row and freshly measure the surviving guest. Test-only probes expose scope, known/age status and marker TTL; they never set telemetry or simulation data.

build.sh OUTPUT, execute.py PREPARED [LABEL], web.sh PREPARED FRESH_WEB_OUTPUT and execute_web.sh WEB_EXPORT FRESH_RUN retain preparation hashes and exact drivers. GDScript-only fixture revisions use separate exports/runs. Production gameplay, canonical world data and original Cavecrawl files are unchanged.
